fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private access road off Manning Bridge Rd feeds a fully tree-lined / fenced property with a continuous perimeter loop road; the driveway pinches to one throat at the NW. No public Street View coverage onto the private drive, so the barrier-arm itself is not directly imaged, but a Target upstream import DC of this scale is access-controlled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-car guard booth structure is visible at the entrance throat or anywhere along the perimeter in z18-z20 satellite. The small structures seen are a stormwater detention control (twin circular ponds, north end) and a paved laydown/maintenance area inside the yard, neither a gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack imaged -> kiosk / appointment / app check-in implied, consistent with modern Target upstream DC operations.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron and an internal laydown area on the NE yard side provide inside-gate holding before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock apron with dock-leveler rhythm and trailers backed in runs essentially the full ~1 km NE building face; conservative estimate ~120 doors -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large marked trailer drop yard on the NE with many rows of parked trailers; capacity well into the hundreds -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and ample paved width on the perimeter drive give room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane count at the gate not resolvable from overhead imagery; assumed 1 in / 1 out at a single shared gate.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale pad identified in the truck path; low confidence given imagery limits.
